name: update_listing
title: Update Listing
description: Create or modify the user's freeform Airsup20 listing via ChatGPT, including pictures. You CAN upload pictures. If the user attached image(s) or asked to add a photo, you MUST pass those files in media on this SAME call as the text/price — never save the listing first and the picture later. Each media item is a ChatGPT file object: {download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name}. If you only have a local file location, put that string in url or download_url. Never send a path field. Optional caption. Examples: sell a chair with photos and price, add a PayPal QR image, publish skills. Listing is user-controlled projection — never dump the whole knowledge/intent database into it.

note.description: Natural-language description of what to add or change.

patch.description: Freeform listing fields to merge (or replace if replace=true).

replace.description: If true, replace listing body with patch instead of merging.

media.description: User pictures/files for this listing. Always include every attached image here on the first call. Preferred: ChatGPT file objects with download_url and file_id. Fallback: url or data_base64. If you only have a local file location, put it in url or download_url — never in path.

download_url.description: ChatGPT file download URL, http(s) URL, or the local file location ChatGPT has. Preferred field for any file location.

url.description: Same as download_url. Use this if you are not passing a ChatGPT file object. Local file locations belong here, not in path.

data_base64.description: Raw image bytes as base64 when no URL is available.

caption.description: Short caption for the picture, e.g. product name.

path.description: Do not use. If you only have a local file location, put it in url or download_url instead. Accepted only as a compatibility alias for url.
